snippet.title: Twice the Eggs ≠ Twice the Chance
snippet.description:
More eggs help, but doubling your eggs doesn't double your chance. In one clinic's model, at 34, going from 10 to 20 mature eggs took the chance of a baby from about 5 out of 10 to nearly 7. And extra freezing cycles helped only because they added eggs: what counts is the total number of mature eggs.

Full video: https://youtu.be/J21RLRUE1g8

Source: Cascante et al., Journal of Assisted Reproduction and Genetics 2024 (NYU, 731 women) — https://doi.org/10.1007/s10815-024-03175-w

English voice generated with AI from Dr Aksoy's own voice; lip movements adjusted with AI. Educational only, not personal medical advice.
